name: Wooden Key
summary: The Wooden Key is a simple carved key carried by the maddened ancients roaming northern Ashenvale near the border of Felwood. It unlocks a concealed chest holding a remnant of Dartol's Rod, an ancient night elven relic.

sections.title: A Key in Mad Hands
sections.body: The Wooden Key is held by the Crazed and Withered Ancients wandering the shaded trails north of Raynewood Retreat. Shael'dryn once knew the local treants, but now describes their nature as twisted by corruption. One of them carries the key to a chest holding a piece of Dartol's Rod.

sections.title: Unlocking the Rod
sections.body: The dryad Shael'dryn tasks adventurers with retrieving this key to open a hidden worn chest nestled in a small glade west of the Felwood road. Inside rests the Iron Shaft, one of the crucial components needed to reconstruct Dartol's Rod and combat the spreading corruption poisoning the sacred forests.

faq.q: What does the Wooden Key unlock?
faq.answer: The Wooden Key opens a worn chest tucked away in a small glade west of the main road heading north into Felwood. Inside the chest lies the Iron Shaft, a piece needed to rebuild Dartol's Rod.
The key is carried by Crazed Ancients and Withered Ancients wandering the woods north of Raynewood Retreat near the Felwood border.

faq.q: Why do the ancients have this key?
aliases: why do treants have the key
faq.answer: Shael'dryn says that one of the corrupted treants near Felwood carries the key. She does not explain how it came into the treant's possession.

faq.q: Who sends you to retrieve the Wooden Key?
faq.answer: Shael'dryn, a dryad tending the Moonwell of Purity in Ashenvale, directs adventurers to recover the key as part of the effort to reassemble Dartol's Rod.

angles.text: Seeing the beloved ancients of Kalimdor driven mad and clutching lost relics along the Felwood road is a sorrowful sight for any child of the stars.
The twisted ancients holding this key reflect the tragic reach of the demonic blight poisoning the Cenarion groves between Ashenvale and Felwood.
